original_title: Glycoconjugate strategy for GLUT-driven curcumin delivery and anticancer activity in breast cancer cells
title: Dressing curcumin up as sugar to sneak it into GLUT-hungry cancer cells
blurb: Cancer cells overexpress glucose transporters, so the play here is a curcumin-glucosamine Schiff base ligand complexed with vanadyl, VO(CG)2, meant to hitch a ride on GLUT transporters into breast cancer cells. It's a synthesis-and-cell-culture paper, so the anticancer activity is against cultured cells, nothing further along yet.

original_title: Polyvinyl alcohol (PVA)-based gel dosimeters for radiotherapy: A review
title: PVA gel dosimeters still can't shake their old problems
blurb: A review of polyvinyl alcohol gel dosimeters for 3D radiotherapy dosing, appealing on paper for being water-rich, optically readable, and chemically tunable. But after repeated formulation rounds they're still stuck outside mainstream clinical use over ferric-ion diffusion, auto-oxidation, inconsistent sensitivity, and a lack of real standardization.
venue: Journal of Radiation Research and Applied Sciences

original_title: Clinical evaluation of Chang attenuation-correction parameterization for CT-free 177Lu SPECT organ quantification: implications for safety dosimetry
title: Testing the Chang correction on CT-free 177Lu SPECT dosimetry
blurb: A clinical evaluation of Chang attenuation-correction parameterization for quantifying organ doses on 177Lu SPECT without a CT scan, aimed at safety dosimetry work.

original_title: Synthesis and evaluation of [<sup>68</sup>Ga]Ga-DOTA-Pip-PEP-4 derivatives for imaging gastrin-releasing peptide receptor expression with positron emission tomography
title: Another 68Ga-DOTA-Pip-PEP-4 entry for GRPR PET imaging
blurb: Same class of tracer, DOTA-Pip-PEP-4 peptide derivatives carrying gallium-68, synthesized and evaluated for imaging gastrin-releasing peptide receptor expression by PET. No efficacy or comparative numbers given, just that it's been made and tested.

original_title: First-Line HER2 ADC and Anti–PD-1 Plus Chemo Shows Efficacy in Gastric Cancer
title: Pushing a HER2 ADC into first-line gastric cancer, PD-1 inhibitor riding along
blurb: Disitamab vedotin, the HER2-targeting ADC carrying MMAE that's currently approved in China only as third-line therapy for HER2-overexpressing gastric/GEJ adenocarcinoma, is now showing efficacy paired with an anti-PD-1 and chemo as first-line treatment. Moving an ADC that far up the treatment line is the actual news here, not the combination itself.

original_title: SIMULTANEOUS ESTIMATION OF NEW ANALYTICAL METHOD DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION OF DAPALIFLOZIN AND VILDAGLIPTIN BY HIGH PERFORMANCE LIQUID CHROMATOGRAPHY
title: One HPLC run for both halves of a dapagliflozin-vildagliptin combo pill
blurb: A QbD/DoE-built RP-HPLC method to quantify dapagliflozin, an SGLT2 inhibitor, and vildagliptin, a DPP-4 inhibitor, simultaneously, the standard combo used for type 2 diabetes. Analytical housekeeping rather than new pharmacology, but useful if you're QC-ing the combination product.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

original_title: Synthesis Control Strategies and Methodological Advances in the Complex Stereochemistry of Tetrodotoxin
title: Nine stereocenters, one tiny cage: the tetrodotoxin synthesis playbook
blurb: A review tracking the strategies chemists have thrown at tetrodotoxin's densely packed cage skeleton and its nine consecutive chiral centers, from chiral-pool starting materials through substrate-controlled and reagent-controlled routes to catalytic asymmetric synthesis. A survey piece, not a new route, but a useful map of how the field's approach to that stereochemical nightmare has evolved.

original_title: Polyphosphate-crosslinked hydrogels: structural design and bioactivity for tissue engineering scaffolds.
title: Polyphosphate as the crosslinker in tissue-engineering hydrogels
blurb: A hydrogel scaffold built on polyphosphate crosslinks, with the structural design tied to bioactivity for tissue engineering. Thin on detail but that's the gist.

original_title: Divergent Synthesis of (+)-Kuhistanicaol G and (+)-Ferutinin through the Common Intermediate Jaeschkeanadiol
title: One intermediate, two anticancer natural products
blurb: A divergent synthesis of (+)-kuhistanicaol G and (+)-ferutinin off a shared intermediate, jaeschkeanadiol, using tandem radical addition/allylation, chelation-controlled nucleophilic addition, and a Chugaev elimination to fork the routes. Both compounds are active against PANC-1 pancreatic cancer cells, and the platform is built for cranking out analogues, so more of these are presumably coming.

original_title: Activity-based chemical proteomics uncovers unexpected covalent targetsof E64d and reveals a role for cysteine cathepsins in PLD3 proteostasis.
title: The cathepsin inhibitor everyone uses turns out to hit more than cathepsins
blurb: Activity-based proteomics on E64d, the go-to covalent blocker of cysteine cathepsin proteolysis, turns up unexpected covalent targets beyond the ones it's sold for. Along the way it pins cysteine cathepsins as the proteases that process PLD3, the exonuclease tied to Alzheimer's, a cleavage step that had no assigned enzyme until now.

original_title: Rh(III)-Catalyzed Multicomponent Cascade Reaction of 2-Arylimidazo[1,2- a ]pyridines with CF3-Imidoyl Sulfoxonium Ylides via Multiple C–H Activation
title: Five new bonds in one pot via Rh(III) C–H activation
blurb: A Rh(III)-catalyzed cascade pushes 2-arylimidazo[1,2-a]pyridines and CF3-imidoyl sulfoxonium ylides through double C–H activation, cyclization, hydrolysis, and aldol condensation, stitching together five bonds in a single pot to give CF3-fused imidazopyridines in moderate-to-excellent yields.

original_title: In situ generation of active motifs on Ni/Al<sub>2</sub>O<sub>3</sub> during partial oxidation of methane to syngas
title: The syngas catalyst's active site wasn't the metal after all
blurb: Partial oxidation of methane to syngas on Ni/Al2O3 has always been chalked up to metallic Ni. In situ spectroscopy and microscopy plus DFT here pin the active sites on specific Ni-O motifs instead, which rewrites the mechanism everyone assumed.

original_title: A Heating-Assisted Integrated Purification-Enrichment-Derivatization Paper Chip for Rapid MS/MS Quantification of Serum Steroid Hormones
title: A paper chip that preps steroid hormones for MS/MS in one heated step
blurb: Quantifying serum steroid hormone panels, for things like PCOS (rebranded here as PMOS), usually means grinding through sample prep and long chromatography to dodge ion suppression in serum. This folds purification, enrichment, and derivatization into a single heated paper chip ahead of MS/MS, aimed at high-throughput screening instead of the slow version.

original_title: Creating New Access Points for Strategic Synthase Engineering: Ethane Thioester Analogs as Truncated Coenzyme A Building Blocks Unlock Expanded Acyl Carrier Protein Loading Capabilities
title: Truncated CoA mimics give polyketide synthases new loading options
blurb: Fatty acid and polyketide synthases are picky: the acyltransferase only loads specific malonyl-CoA building blocks onto the acyl carrier protein, which caps what you can swap into the final product. Ethane thioester analogs, used as truncated CoA building blocks, open new entry points for expanding what the ACP will accept, a lever for engineering these pathways toward different analogues.

original_title: Microstructural insights and mechanical properties of physically crosslinked starch hydrogels via two-way amylose regulation.
title: Tuning starch hydrogels by dialing amylose content both ways
blurb: Physically crosslinked starch hydrogels made by regulating amylose content in both directions, with microstructure and mechanical properties tracked against it.

original_title: Structural insights into antibody-antibody interactions in sandwich ELISA: implications for assay development and performance
title: Why some antibody pairs just won't work together in a sandwich ELISA
blurb: Sandwich ELISAs for measuring human mAb therapeutics in nonclinical studies usually lean on generic human-specific capture/detection antibody pairs, and picking a pair that actually works together is mostly trial and error. This maps the structural basis of antibody-antibody interactions within the sandwich to explain why some pairings click and others don't.

original_title: Electricity-ControlledDivergent Synthesis of CF3-Tethered Pyrazolinesand Pyrazoles via Tandem RadicalTrifluoromethylation and Annulation
title: Electricity picks pyrazoline or pyrazole from the same starting materials
blurb: A metal- and oxidant-free electrochemical route runs a tandem radical trifluoromethylation/annulation on N-allyl-N'-benzylidenesulfonohydrazides and CF3SO2Na, and the applied electricity alone steers the product toward CF3-tethered pyrazolines or pyrazoles from the same feedstock, across more than 45 examples.

original_title: Highly Transparent Layer-by-Layer Nanoassembled Multicomponent Films of TiO2 and Graphene for Increased Photocatalytic Performance
title: Transparent TiO2/graphene films that don't block the light they need
blurb: Layer-by-layer assembled TiO2 nanoparticles and few-layer graphene, not reduced graphene oxide, so the graphene keeps its native conductivity, stacked into a nanoporous film via a plain aqueous process. Transparent enough to let photons through while still getting efficient charge separation at the interface, which is usually the trade-off in these films.
venue: Journal of the American Chemical Society

original_title: Photochemical Cobalt-Catalyzed Selective Olefin Hydrogenation and One-Bond Transposition
title: One cobalt catalyst, two outcomes: hydrogenate or just shuffle the double bond
blurb: A (salen)Co metallaphotoredox system generates the same alkyl/Co(II) radical pair via MHAT for both olefin hydrogenation and monoisomerization, using a non-gaseous hydrogen source instead of an H2 tank. Which path you get is a matter of downstream selectivity, not a different catalyst, which is the neat part.

original_title: Bimodal multiphoton catalysis via structural regeneration
title: One photocatalyst, two redox windows via structural regeneration
blurb: A two-photon bimodal catalysis scheme where the same light-activated photocatalyst generates reactive intermediates at opposite ends of the redox scale, regenerating its own structure in between. Widens the accessible redox window without swapping catalysts mid-reaction.

original_title: Synthetic PS-III Glycoconjugate Vaccines Based on Solid-Phase Assembled Well-Defined Oligosaccharides Confers Protection against Clostridium difficile
title: A made-to-spec C. diff vaccine antigen, finally synthesized cleanly
blurb: PS-III's di-GlcNAc repeats are potently immunogenic but nobody could make them with defined structure, which has kept the antigen from being properly tested. Solid-phase assembly of well-defined PS-III oligosaccharide glycoconjugates gets protection in this study, against a bug that has no licensed vaccine and kills about 12,800 people a year in the US.

original_title: Stable and Active AuCu and AuPd Electrocatalysts for Platinum-Free Oxygen Reduction Reaction: Design Principles from Ligand–Strain Coupling and Gold Surface Segregation
title: Why AuCu and AuPd don't need platinum to do oxygen reduction
blurb: First-principles modeling of AuCu and AuPd surface-subsurface alloys across the full range from pure metals to segregated configurations, mapping how ligand and strain effects couple with gold's habit of segregating to the surface to set stability and adsorption energetics. Design rules for platinum-free ORR catalysts, from calculation rather than the electrochemistry bench.

original_title: Polyoxometalates‐Driven Oxidative Polymerization of Thioctic Acid and Synchronized Noncovalent Cross‐Linking to Generate High‐Strength and Colorimetric Adhesives
title: An adhesive that cross-links itself and changes color to prove it
blurb: A polyoxometalate mediates ring-opening polymerization of thioctic acid while simultaneously driving noncovalent cross-linking, so the strength-building and the degradability-preserving happen in the same mild step instead of trading off against each other like they usually do in disulfide-backbone polymers. The colorimetric readout is a nice bonus if it holds up outside the lab.

original_title: Dehydroxylative Cross-Electrophile Coupling of Aromatic Acids with Glycosyl Chlorides Enables Rapid C -Acyl Glycoside Synthesis
title: C-acyl glycosides straight from carboxylic acids, no pre-activation needed
blurb: A nickel/photoredox/phosphoranyl radical relay couples aromatic acids directly with glycosyl chlorides, using a phosphine radical cation to crack the acid's strong C-O bond and generate the acyl radical in situ. Stereoselective, and it works across furanoses and pyranoses without having to activate the carboxylic acid first.

original_title: Starch granules are instructive scaffolds for synergistic reinforcement and dissipation in hydrogel composites
title: Starch granules as the scaffold, not just the filler, in hydrogel composites
blurb: Starch granules reinforce and dissipate energy inside hydrogel composites at the same time, doing two structural jobs that usually need separate additives.

original_title: Beyond Molecular Dispersion: A Molecular-Cone Architecture of Cobalt Phthalocyanine on CNTs for Selective CO2 Electroreduction to Methanol
title: A cone-shaped catalyst geometry to keep cobalt phthalocyanine from clumping
blurb: Nitro-substituted cobalt phthalocyanine on carbon nanotubes forms a distinct molecular-cone arrangement instead of the usual pick between molecularly dispersed (good selectivity, low loading) or aggregated (high loading, bad selectivity). Lets them push loading up for higher current density on CO2-to-methanol without paying the usual aggregation penalty.

original_title: Evaluation of analytical reliability based on variance index score, measurement uncertainty and root cause analysis in a 2-year external quality assessment scheme
title: Two years of external quality assessment data, mined for where a lab's results actually slip
blurb: 1,853 EQAS results across 68 analytes from an accredited clinical biochemistry lab, run through variance index score, measurement uncertainty, and root cause analysis together rather than any one metric alone. Unglamorous audit work, but exactly what you'd want if you're the one signing off on the lab's results.

original_title: Titanium-catalyzed Cross-coupling of Aryl Boronate Derivatives and Aryl Halides en Route to Biaryl Backbones
title: A titanium catalyst does Suzuki couplings without the palladium
blurb: Titanium standing in for Pd in aryl halide/boronic acid couplings, hitting 98% yield across 60 examples with decent functional group tolerance. They ran it gram-scale and used it to build an Orelabrutinib intermediate, so it's not just a substrate-scope flex.

original_title: Near-Atomic Indium Catalysts Enable Cost-Efficient High-Pressure Reverse Water–Gas Shift
title: A near-atomic indium catalyst that survives high-pressure RWGS
blurb: Indium clusters on monoclinic ZrO2, held in place by In-O-Zr interfacial bonding, resist sintering and over-reduction at the industrial pressures that usually kill RWGS catalysts. If the stability holds outside the lab, it's a cheaper CO2-to-CO route than the usual noble-metal options.

original_title: Laser absorption spectroscopy measurements of neutral N$$_2$$O in a radio frequency plasma
title: Watching N2O concentrations inside a plasma with a laser instead of a pressure gauge
blurb: A quantum cascade laser tuned to a single N2O rovibrational line, fitted with a Gaussian to pull out neutral density, checked against plain pressure-gauge readings both with and without the RF plasma running. It matched. A diagnostic paper, but a useful one if you're trying to see what a plasma is actually doing to your gas.

original_title: Scalable Annulation Approach to Functionalized 1-Azabicycloalkanes
title: One annulation route, four different bicyclic amine cores
blurb: A TMEDA-controlled lithium amide alkylation of cyclic amino esters, followed by cyclization, reaches azabicycloheptane, pyrrolizidine, indolizidine, and quinolizidine cores from one scalable sequence. They also mapped which structural features help or kill the ring closure, and say the resulting amines behave fine in standard med-chem workflows.

original_title: Constructing multifunctional biointerfaces: Polyoxometalate-based hydrogels—design, functionalization, and translational challenges
title: Polyoxometalate hydrogels, reviewed for wound healing, antimicrobials, tumors, and bioelectronics
blurb: A review of POM hydrogels, hybrids that fold the catalytic, redox, photothermal, and electrochemical tricks of polyoxometalates into a polymer network you can actually put on tissue. Covers composition and network design across four applications, but it's a review, so treat it as a map of the field rather than new data.

original_title: Unlocking a Novel [2+1+1+1+1] Coordination Framework through One-Pot Synthesis of an AIE-Active Iridium(III) Photoredox Catalyst for Enhanced Photocytotoxicity via Apoptosis, Ferroptosis, and Oncotic-like Cell Death
title: An AIE iridium photosensitizer that kills tumor cells three different ways at once
blurb: A one-pot Ir(III) complex built around a [2+1+1+1+1] coordination framework, aggregation-induced emission active so it doesn't quench itself, aimed at PDT's usual failure modes: oxygen dependence and glutathione mopping up the ROS. It's reported to trigger apoptosis, ferroptosis, and oncotic-like death together, which is the actual selling point over a single-pathway killer.

original_title: Ring Contraction of Bicyclic Lactams: A Molecular Editing Aza-Favorski-Type Approach to Tetrahydroquinoline-2-carboxylic Acids
title: Shrinking a bicyclic lactam ring to make tetrahydroquinoline acids
blurb: An aza-Favorski-style ring contraction, silylation then Pb(OAc)4-driven oxidation, turns benzazepinones into substituted tetrahydroquinoline-2-carboxylic acids at up to 67% yield. It stretches to bigger ring homologues too, just with worse yields there.

original_title: Single-turnover subparticle imaging reveals kinetic compensation in electrocatalytic surface water dissociation
title: Watching single catalyst particles dissociate water one turnover at a time
blurb: DELINE, a single-turnover imaging technique with subparticle resolution, maps electrocatalytic water dissociation across a particle's surface rather than averaging the whole thing together, and turns up kinetic compensation, sites trading off activation energy against pre-factor, that bulk measurements would just blur out.

original_title: Atropisomeric Properties of N-Aryl 5H-dibenz[b,f]azepines
title: Axial chirality in dibenzazepines, and what makes it stick around
blurb: N-aryl dibenz[b,f]azepines separated into individual atropisomers by chiral HPLC, with electron-withdrawing groups on the pendant aryl ring raising the barrier to interconversion. Useful if you actually want a stable atropisomer rather than one that racemizes on the bench, since ring conformation here tracks with biological activity.

original_title: Structure-Based Computational Evaluation and Pharmacokinetic Profiling of Chelator-Functionalized Eugenol and Thymol Derivatives for Predicted Interaction with Bacterial DNA Gyrase
title: Docking chelator-tagged eugenol and thymol against bacterial DNA gyrase, all in silico
blurb: Two clove-and-thyme-derived phenolics get a diethanolamine chelator bolted on via Mannich modification, then get docked against DNA gyrase and run through predicted pharmacokinetics. Pure computation here, no assay yet, so it's a shortlist for testing rather than evidence the compounds actually work.

original_title: Zn‐Assisted Evaporation‐Pyrolysis Strategy to Prepare Tannic Acid‐Derived Fe‐Fe 3 C‐Fe 3 O 4 @CN‐l Catalyst for Selective Hydrogenation of Nitroarenes
title: A tannic-acid-derived iron catalyst that skips the noble metals for nitroarene hydrogenation
blurb: Fe-Fe3C-Fe3O4 embedded in nitrogen-doped carbon, made by pyrolyzing biomass tannic acid with zinc as a sacrificial aid. The pitch is a cheap, durable non-noble-metal catalyst for selective nitroarene-to-arylamine hydrogenation under mild conditions, a reaction that usually still leans on Pd or Pt.

original_title: Introduction of optimized folate group modification on lipid-coated magnetic nanobeads enables targeting of folate receptor beta
title: Retuning folate targeting from tumor cells to tumor-associated macrophages
blurb: Lipid-coated magnetic nanobeads get an optimized folate modification aimed at folate receptor beta instead of the usual alpha. FR-beta sits on macrophages tied to tumors and inflammation sites, so the point is hitting the immune cells around the tumor rather than the tumor cells themselves.
venue: Journal of Colloid and Interface Science

original_title: Telix Pharmaceuticals (ASX:TLX): Radiopharmaceutical Growth and US$1 Billion Revenue Pathway - kalkine.com.au
title: Telix pitches itself as a billion-dollar radiopharma story
blurb: An investor write-up framing Telix Pharmaceuticals' radiopharmaceutical pipeline as a path to a billion dollars in revenue. Standard stock-coverage stuff, so treat it as marketing until the actual revenue numbers show up.

original_title: Phosphorothioate-Enabled Cas12a Autocatalytic Network for Amplification-Free Ultrasensitive Nucleic Acid Detection
title: An autocatalytic Cas12a circuit that doesn't need PCR to see a signal
blurb: Autocatalytic CRISPR detection usually gets wrecked by Cas12a chewing up ssDNA indiscriminately and by needing fussy, unstable DNA scaffolds. This version leans on F. novicida Cas12a's tolerance for fully phosphorothioate-modified ssDNA activators, using a PS-flanked ssDNA mediator to keep the network selective while going after amplification-free, ultrasensitive nucleic acid detection.

original_title: Adsorption-regeneration-recycling: A multi-site self-crosslinked hydrogel combined with carbonization for the efficient removal of cationic dyes and heavy metal ions from wastewater.
title: A hydrogel that adsorbs wastewater dyes and metals, then gets carbonized for another round
blurb: A multi-site self-crosslinked hydrogel pulls cationic dyes and heavy metal ions out of wastewater, then gets regenerated through carbonization for reuse. Adsorb, regenerate, recycle, repeat, with no cycle count offered on how long that actually holds up.

original_title: A permeable protein nanocage enables facile cargo loading and cytosolic protein delivery
title: A permeable protein nanocage that loads its own cargo
blurb: An encapsulin-based nanocage, QtEnc, is unexpectedly permeable, letting cargo proteins diffuse in and load themselves after the cage is already assembled instead of needing the usual engineered loading tricks. It handles cargo as large as 482 kDa and allows multiplexed co-encapsulation at tunable ratios. So far it's all in vitro, so cytosolic protein delivery is the goal being aimed at, not the thing actually shown yet.

original_title: HydrogenBonding Networks Formed by Hydroxyl-FunctionalizedN-Heterocyclic Carbenes on Ag(111)
title: Building hydrogen-bonded networks out of NHCs instead of thiols on silver
blurb: N-heterocyclic carbenes are the sturdier alternative to thiol surface chemistry, but getting them to self-assemble into ordered hydrogen-bonded networks has been the sticking point. A hydroxyl-functionalized NHC, IMes-OH, manages it on Ag(111), with the OH groups doing the hydrogen bonding that could end up tuning how adsorbates sit on the surface.

original_title: Gold nanoparticle-based colorimetric detection of ATP via a label-free aptamer
title: A gold nanoparticle color change for reading out ATP, no labels needed
blurb: An ATP aptamer paired with unmodified gold nanoparticles: the aptamer binds ATP, which changes how the particles aggregate in high salt, and you read the result off as a color shift. Aimed at replacing electrophoresis, chromatography, and bioluminescence setups with something simpler and cheaper, in the way these label-free colorimetric assays always promise.

original_title: An indocyanine green-potentiated gastrin releasing peptide receptor-targeting multifunctional peptide-drug conjugate for prostate cancer therapy.
title: A peptide-drug conjugate that doubles as its own tracking dye
blurb: Indocyanine green built into a gastrin-releasing peptide receptor-targeting conjugate, so the prostate cancer drug carries its own near-infrared beacon along for the ride.

original_title: Katy Beckermann: The Largest Real-World Radioligand Dataset in Prostate Cancer - Oncodaily
title: The biggest real-world radioligand dataset in prostate cancer, apparently
blurb: Katy Beckermann discussing what's being billed as the largest real-world radioligand therapy dataset assembled in prostate cancer. Scale claims like that are easy to make in a headline and harder to check without the actual numbers.

original_title: Raffaele Colombo: New Insights Into ADC Linker Stability and Clinical Translation - Oncodaily
title: What actually keeps an ADC linker together in the clinic
blurb: Raffaele Colombo on antibody-drug conjugate linker stability and how it plays out in clinical translation. Linker chemistry is the unglamorous part of ADC design that quietly decides whether the payload lands where it's supposed to.

original_title: Recent advances in PSMA therapy - from beta to alpha.
title: PSMA therapy's shift from beta to alpha emitters
blurb: A review tracking where PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy stands as alpha emitters start muscling in on the Lu-177 beta-emitter incumbents. Stock-taking rather than new data.

original_title: Continuous-FlowElectrosynthesis beyond Scaleup
title: Flow electrochemistry is more than a scale-up trick
blurb: A conspectus arguing continuous-flow electrolysis isn't just process intensification for scaling up batch electrochemistry. Short residence times, electrode conditions that shift as you move down the flow path, fast mass transfer, and distinct interfacial microenvironments open up reactivity a scaled-up beaker just doesn't have.

original_title: Acetylene Semi‐Hydrogenation by Photocatalysis
title: Swapping hydrogen gas for light in acetylene hydrogenation
blurb: Acetylene-to-ethylene semi-hydrogenation normally runs on noble metals and a lot of energy; this minireview covers the push to do it photocatalytically instead, generating the reactive intermediates with light and using water or alcohols in place of H2. The authors call the field early-stage, but the selectivity and efficiency numbers already coming out of it aren't bad for infancy.

original_title: Prognostic value of the dual-tracer PET score (NETPET) in neuroendocrine tumors with [225Ac]Ac-DOTATATE therapy
title: A dual-tracer PET score for who actually benefits from Ac-225-DOTATATE
blurb: The NETPET score, built from two PET tracers, gets tested for prognostic value in neuroendocrine tumor patients on Ac-225-DOTATATE therapy.
venue: European Journal of Nuclear Medicine and Molecular Imaging

original_title: DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION OF A STABILITY-INDICATING RP-HPLC METHOD FOR SIMULTANEOUS ESTIMATION OF ACECLOFENAC AND TIZANIDINE HYDROCHLORIDE IN BULK DRUG AND PHARMACEUTICAL DOSAGE FORM
title: An HPLC method to keep tabs on an NSAID/muscle-relaxant combo pill
blurb: A stability-indicating RP-HPLC method validated for measuring aceclofenac and tizanidine together in the same dosage form, the unglamorous analytical groundwork a fixed-dose combination needs before it can ship.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

original_title: Progress in the application of (177)Lu- and (225)Ac-targeted radionuclide therapy in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma.
title: Radioligand therapy's slow crawl into pancreatic cancer
blurb: A review of where Lu-177 and Ac-225-targeted radionuclide therapy stand in pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma, a tumor that's given targeted radioligand approaches a much harder time than prostate cancer has.

original_title: Protein farnesylation: from molecular mechanisms to therapeutic targeting in cancer, aging, and beyond
title: Farnesylation, from CaaX motif to cancer target, in one review
blurb: Farnesyltransferase tacks a 15-carbon farnesyl lipid onto CaaX-motif cysteines, setting the localization and activity of Ras GTPases, nuclear lamins, chaperones, and kinetochore proteins. This review covers FTase enzymology and substrate recognition, the RCE1/ICMT processing that follows, and the growing farnesylated proteome tied to cancer and aging. Ground covered, not new data.

original_title: A Modular Synthesis of C5‐Sulfenyl Thiazoles via an Intermolecular Pummerer Rearrangement: An Underexplored Scaffold for Medicinal Chemistry
title: A mild route into sulfur-substituted thiazoles nobody bothered making
blurb: Sulfenyl thiazoles are genuinely useful in med chem, better PK, extra vectors for elaboration, maybe better binding, but the scaffold's been mostly skipped because making it was a pain. This paper builds C5-sulfenyl thiazoles from β-keto sulfoxides via an intermolecular Pummerer rearrangement, mild and modular enough to actually use.

original_title: Bimodal multiphoton catalysis via structural regeneration
title: One photocatalyst, two redox directions
blurb: Most organic photocatalysts are stuck working one redox manifold at a time. This one absorbs two photons and reversibly falls apart into three reactive fragments spanning a 5.7 V redox window, so it can drive oxidative and reductive steps off the same molecule and then reassemble. The regeneration is the actual trick, not just a bigger redox range.

original_title: Analytical quality by design based HPLC method development validation and green assessment for tenofovir alafenamide quantification in ultradeformable vesicles
title: Quality-by-design HPLC for tenofovir alafenamide in lipid vesicles
blurb: A QbD workflow built around a defined analytical target profile and risk assessment, rather than the usual trial and error, to develop and validate an HPLC method for quantifying TAF in ultradeformable vesicle formulations, with a green-chemistry assessment tacked on. Useful if you're running this exact assay, skippable otherwise.

original_title: Column switching liquid chromatography dual mass spectrometry system for simultaneous untargeted metabolomics and targeted exposomics
title: One LC-MS run for both the metabolome and the exposome
blurb: Exposome studies usually need separate methods to catch polar and nonpolar compounds across a huge concentration range. This column-switching 2DLC-dual-MS setup separates both in one run, log P from -8 to 15, and routes the fractions to a high-res MS and a triple quad at once, untargeted metabolomics and targeted exposure chemicals from the same injection.

original_title: Dynamic helical poly[4]helicene nanoribbon
title: A helical graphene nanoribbon folded shut from a floppy precursor
blurb: First synthesis of a poly[4]helicene nanoribbon, made by taking a nonhelical precursor polymer and cyclizing it shut, quantitatively, into a chain of [4]helicene units. Each unit is individually configurationally labile, but they're mechanically coupled to their neighbors, so handedness propagates down the ribbon instead of scrambling.

original_title: Tumor heterogeneity in metastatic prostate cancer: Limitations on the efficacy of prostate-specific membrane antigen radioligand therapy.
title: Tumor heterogeneity is why PSMA radioligand therapy doesn't work on everyone
blurb: Makes the case that uneven PSMA expression across metastases in prostate cancer caps how well PSMA-targeted radioligand therapy can perform, since lesions with little or no PSMA just don't take up the dose. A limitations piece rather than new trial data.

original_title: DEVELOPMENT AND VALIDATION OF A STABILITY-INDICATING RP-HPLC METHOD FOR SIMULTANEOUS ESTIMATION OF ACECLOFENAC AND TIZANIDINE HYDROCHLORIDE IN BULK DRUG AND PHARMACEUTICAL DOSAGE FORM
title: One HPLC run for aceclofenac and tizanidine together
blurb: A stability-indicating RP-HPLC method developed and validated to quantify aceclofenac, the NSAID, and tizanidine hydrochloride, the muscle relaxant, simultaneously in bulk drug and tablet form. Straightforward combo-drug QC work.
venue: Zenodo (CERN European Organization for Nuclear Research)

original_title: High-entropy engineering of spinel catalysts for nonradical catalytic ozonation with improved resistance to humidity and sulfur poisoning
title: A high-entropy catalyst that ozonates sulfur pollutants without getting poisoned by them
blurb: Catalytic ozonation of sulfur pollutants usually degrades because hydroxyl radicals oxidize indiscriminately and sulfate byproducts kill the metal sites. This high-entropy spinel, (CuNiMnCo)Fe2O4, uses sublattice-resolved electronic reconstruction to activate ozone selectively and resist that poisoning, hitting 99% removal of methyl mercaptan against 51% for plain CoFe2O4, backed by spectroscopy and DFT rather than just the headline number.

original_title: Mesenchymal Stem Cell-Laden Nanofibril-Reinforced Injectable and Self-Healing Alginate Dialdehyde/Gelatin Hydrogels with Enhanced Mechanical and Chondrogenic Performance In Vitro.
title: A self-healing hydrogel loaded with stem cells and aimed at cartilage
blurb: An injectable, self-healing alginate dialdehyde/gelatin hydrogel reinforced with nanofibrils and seeded with mesenchymal stem cells, showing better mechanical strength and chondrogenic performance than the unreinforced version. All in vitro so far, nothing on whether it holds up as actual cartilage in vivo.

original_title: Hybrid Dynamic-Covalent PEG Hydrogels With Enhanced Stability for Photothermally Triggered Pulsatile Drug Delivery.
title: A PEG hydrogel that dumps its drug payload on a light cue, repeatedly
blurb: Dynamic-covalent crosslinks built into a PEG hydrogel for extra stability while keeping it photothermally triggerable, so it releases drug in pulses on command instead of just leaking it out over time.

original_title: Identifying and Regulating the Active Metal Sites in Heterogeneous Ni-Based Catalysts for Ethylene Oligomerization
title: The active site in Ni ethylene-oligomerization catalysts isn't NiO or Ni0 after all
blurb: Industry runs ethylene oligomerization on homogeneous Ni catalysts, and everyone's been arguing about what actually does the work in the heterogeneous silica-alumina-supported versions. This study rules out both NiO and metallic Ni0 as the active species, so whatever's catalyzing it is something else entirely, and that's the controversial part nobody's settled.

original_title: Novel thiazolo[5,4-b]pyridine–sulfonamide conjugates: Synthesis, structure–activity relationship, and molecular docking studies
title: New thiazolopyridine-sulfonamides beat the reference antibiotics in vitro
blurb: A set of thiazolo[5,4-b]pyridine sulfonamides built off a cyanoacetyl sulfonamide intermediate, tested against S. aureus, E. coli, and C. albicans. Three of them (10, 16, 21) hit MICs down to 3.125 μg/mL and matched or beat the reference drugs, broad spectrum rather than just one bug. Docking studies are along for the ride, but the MIC numbers are the actual result.

original_title: An injectable polysaccharide hydrogel integrating dynamic network formation with the coagulation cascade for rapid hemostasis.
title: An injectable hydrogel that teams up with your clotting cascade to stop bleeding fast
blurb: A polysaccharide hydrogel that builds its network dynamically while working with the body's own coagulation cascade, aimed at rapid hemostasis, and injectable rather than something you lay on as a patch.

original_title: Sustainable synthesis of corncob-derived graphene quantum dots for versatile electrochemical detection of metabolic biomarkers via SPCE/GQDs@Nafion platform
title: Turning corncobs into graphene quantum dots for a biomarker sensor
blurb: Green, hydrothermal synthesis of graphene quantum dots out of corncob waste, 6.21 nm spheres, mostly carbon with some oxygen, green fluorescence under UV. They're loaded onto a screen-printed carbon electrode with Nafion for multi-analyte electrochemical detection of metabolic biomarkers. Waste-to-sensor is the hook, characterization looks thorough.

original_title: Tailoring Electrolyte Chemistry Through Precise Organic Synthesis for Lithium Metal Batteries
title: A review arguing battery electrolytes need real synthetic chemistry, not just better recipes
blurb: Hitting 500+ Wh/kg with lithium metal anodes and high-voltage cathodes breaks conventional carbonate electrolytes at the interface. This review makes the case for treating electrolyte design as precision organic synthesis at the molecular level instead of empirical formulation tweaking. It's a perspective piece laying out a framework, not new battery data.

original_title: Synthesis, computational analysis and application of the hetero-ligand system Co(II) coordination polymer as catalyst for the degradation of microplastics
title: A cobalt coordination polymer that degrades microplastics, with DFT to explain why
blurb: A Co(II) coordination polymer built from a benzenetetracarboxylic acid ligand and 1-methylimidazole, structure confirmed by single-crystal XRD, then run as a catalyst for microplastic degradation. Backed up with DFT/B3LYP and Monte Carlo work on the binding, kinetics, and thermodynamics. Solid structural case; how it holds up outside the lab degradation assay is the open part.

original_title: Novartis to Build $23B Radioligand Therapy Manufacturing Hub in Texas - Thomasnet
title: Novartis is putting $23B into a Texas radioligand therapy plant
blurb: A new manufacturing hub dedicated to radioligand therapy, priced at $23B, landing in Texas. That's serious capital for a drug class whose manufacturing scale-up is still relatively new.

original_title: Photocatalytic access to α-aminonitriles and α-cyano amides via 1,5-hydrogen atom transfer
title: Photocatalysis threads a 1,5-HAT step to build α-aminonitriles and α-cyano amides
blurb: A photocatalytic route to α-aminonitriles and α-cyano amides that uses 1,5-hydrogen atom transfer to set up the key C–H step. Details are thin beyond the method itself, but getting two different cyanated nitrogen motifs off one HAT-based photocatalytic handle is worth a look.

title: We’re proud to announce the launch of the smallest NMR ever invented: the 1 MHz spectrometer.
blurb: Sure, the peaks might not be as sharp as they are at 600 MHz, but this spectrometer can fit in your pocket, and runs on AAA batteries. PDF is downloadable from https://www.immaterialscience.org/2026/pocketnmr or from r/ImmaterialScience
